title: To $1/2$-logconcavity and beyond: Geometric properties of Dirichlet eigenfunctions
summary: We prove that, on a bounded open convex domain $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, the first Dirichlet eigenfunction of the Laplacian or the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck operator is $α$-logconcave for every $α\in(0,1/2]$. This extends the recent $1/2$-logconcavity theorem of Crasta--Fragalà for the Laplacian to the weighted Gaussian setting and, simultaneously, to a broader range of exponents. More precisely, if $u$ denotes the first eigenfunction normalized by $\|u\|_\infty=1$, then for every $α\in(0,1/2]$, the function $-\bigl(-\log(κu(x))\bigr)^α$ is concave in $Ω$ provided the scaling parameter $κ$ lies…
